schema: docs/INTERFACES.md data/hive_geometry.json; extra keys are additive

frame.definition: HIVE frame per INTERFACES.md: origin on the tile surface directly below the HIVE pivot axis (at the HIVE centre plane), z up, x horizontal in the tipping plane, y along the pivot axis.
frame.cad_mapping: official CAD: X = red(-)/blue(+) axis = pivot axis direction, Y = up (tile top Y=0), Z = audience(+)/scoring(-) axis, origin field centre. HIVE frame: x = Z_cad (positive toward the AUDIENCE side), z = Y_cad, y = X_cad - X_hive (right-handed). Red HIVE centre X_cad = -12.74 in, blue +12.74 in.
frame.prov: confirmed: official field CAD STEP (assembly 'am-5850 BIOBUZZ'), parsed vertices, https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/archive/2027/field/field-cad-step

ball_radius.prov: confirmed: Competition Manual TU07 9.8 (POLLEN approx 2.8 in / 7.1 cm diameter), https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/game/cm-html/BIOBUZZ%20Competition%20Manual%20-%20TU07.htm; 'approximately', so treat +-1 mm as uncertain

pivot.prov: confirmed: Competition Manual TU07 9.6.1 (pivot axis 43.95 in / 111.65 cm above TILES), https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/game/cm-html/BIOBUZZ%20Competition%20Manual%20-%20TU07.htm; CAD axle at Y=43.95 in; low/high = manual 9.1 general +-1 in tolerance

tilt_deg.prov: confirmed nominal 30 deg: confirmed: Competition Manual TU07 9.6.2 Fig 9-10 (angle labelled 30 deg), https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/game/cm-html/BIOBUZZ%20Competition%20Manual%20-%20TU07.htm; and CAD base tube axis measured 30.0 deg (https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/archive/2027/field/field-cad-step). low/high derived: confirmed: Field Acceptance Checklist Rev 26-27.2 item 1.13, https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/archive/2027/field/field-check lip height 53.5+-0.5 in, solved exactly for the tilt with the pivot at nominal -> 28.80-31.77 deg (PM-015, research/GEOMETRY_AUDIT.md row 14; the earlier linear +-1.5 deg estimate 28.5-31.5 is only the label of sweeps precomputed before PM-015). low_wide/high_wide derived: also allow the manual's +-1 in field tolerance (9.1) on pivot height -> 25.90-34.83 deg (exact solve; earlier rounded estimate 25.5-34.5).
tilt_deg.sense: angle of the cell axis above horizontal; the neg-side cell is up, the other cell is down by the same angle

mouth.note: p0 = lower lip (inner edge of mouth rib bottom bar, flush with floor), p1 = upper lip (inner edge of roof band at pentagon peak), centre plane s=0
mouth.prov: derived: CAD cell section rotated by nominal tilt; check: z(p0)=53.41 in vs checklist 53.5+-0.5 in, z(p1)=65.59 in vs Fig 9-10 65.6 in

pose_neg.inside_prov: assumed criterion + derived geometry: ball centre behind the mouth plane and at least R from floor, roof and back wall (centre-plane section). The floor slopes 30 deg down toward the back wall, so a ball that settles inside rolls back and is retained; rebounds back out are for contact.py. NOTE: 3 NECTAR start in each up cell against the back skin and the perimeter-side wall (Event Field Setup Guide 11.1).
pose_neg.reason: The upward CELL is on the neg side and its mouth faces outward and upward: outward normal n = (-cos30, sin30), i.e. 30 deg above horizontal away from the pivot. Entry needs v.n < 0. A shooter on the neg side (ball moving toward +x) enters for any flight-path angle from 90 deg below horizontal up to 60 deg ABOVE horizontal; projected mouth = 0.3574*cos(phi-30deg) m where phi = descent angle (best: descending 30 deg, full 0.357 m; ball-centre window ~0.357-2R = 0.286 m). From the pos side the ball must pass over the roof (ball centre above ~1.713 m = roof top 66.04 in + R) and then descend steeper than 60 deg (geometrically > ~71.5 deg for the ball to fit: 60 + asin(2R/0.3574)); projected mouth = 0.3574*sin(phi-60deg); a vertical drop has a ball-centre window of only ~0.108 m (|x| 0.347-0.455 m). Derived from CAD geometry; tilt 30 deg confirmed.

body_local.description: Rotating HIVE body in the cell-local frame (metres) for tilt sweeps: x = s_pose*(u cos t - w sin t), z = pivot_z + u sin t + w cos t, s_pose = +1 for pose_pos, -1 for pose_neg. u>0 = up cell.

field.hive_position: Both HIVES hang from one A-frame structure at the FIELD centre; pivot axes collinear along the red-blue (alliance wall to alliance wall) axis at 1.1163 m, red HIVE centre 0.3236 m toward the red alliance wall, blue 0.3236 m toward blue. The tipping plane is the audience-scoring axis, so in-plane shots come from the audience side (+x) or the far/scoring side (-x). Frame base 49.46 x 38.95 in (1.256 x 0.989 m); foot bars at x = +-0.495 m. Source: confirmed: Competition Manual TU07 9.6, 9.6.1, https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/game/cm-html/BIOBUZZ%20Competition%20Manual%20-%20TU07.htm + CAD.
field.start_pose: Match start: red HIVE audience-side cell up = pose_pos; blue HIVE scoring-side cell up = pose_neg (x toward audience). Each TIP flips the pose. confirmed: Event Field Setup Guide V1.0 11.1 (https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/archive/2027/field/eventfieldguide), Manual 10.3.1 ('the CELL which points at a FLOWER is tilted down'), and the CAD as delivered.

in_plane_extent.prov: CAD: perimeter wall inner face at 70.90 in from the field centre line (x=0 is the field centre line); manual 9.1 field approx 144 in square

field.legal_shooting_region: No launch zone, launch line or no-go zone for LAUNCHING found in Manual TU07 (zones defined: ALLIANCE AREA, LOADING ZONE, GARDEN only, 9.3). A ROBOT may LAUNCH from anywhere on the FIELD. Constraints: G417 (no HIVE contact/meddling), R105/G416 size, G409 (no catching elements spilled by a TIPPED HIVE). Under-HIVE space is not a zone but the down cell bottom is at 0.778 m and the ACM panel/legs fill the centre. confirmed absence by full-text search of TU07; re-check later Team Updates.

robot_limits.prov: confirmed: Competition Manual TU07 12 R102 (18 in start cube), R105.A (expanded 18 x 24 x 29 in tall, 29 in measured from FIELD surface), G416, https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/game/cm-html/BIOBUZZ%20Competition%20Manual%20-%20TU07.htm
robot_limits.release_height_note: assumed: ball centre at release <= 0.737 m (ball inside the sizing volume; LAUNCHED elements no longer in contact are not ROBOT parts) - a ball partly outside the volume while still in the mechanism is a G416 risk

hive_rules: G417 (MAJOR FOUL + YELLOW CARD if STRATEGIC): ROBOTS may not manipulate HIVE motion except by LAUNCHING into an upward-facing CELL. Likely STRATEGIC: C deliberately LAUNCHING into the external bottom, sides or top faces of a CELL; D LAUNCHING at an opponent HIVE to impede its TIP; E contacting a HIVE directly or through a CONTROLLED element. NOT strategic (H): attempting to LAUNCH into the up CELL and missing so the ball hits the bottom, sides or top of the CELL.
10.5.1: LAUNCHING into the upward-facing CELL is the only allowed way to earn a TIP; LAUNCHING at the down CELL while tipping may disrupt the TIP.

Consequence for design: a planned bank shot off the roof/outer faces is G417 C risk; lip/rim contact during a genuine scoring attempt is covered by example H; contact inside the mouth is part of scoring.
G409: a ROBOT may not catch or deflect a SCORING ELEMENT released by a TIPPED HIVE until it contacts something else.
T405 J: no LAUNCHING during field calibration/measurement time.
field.tip_calibration: Field Acceptance Checklist 2.3-2.6 / Event Field Setup Guide 12: 3 NECTAR + 2 POLLEN no tip, +1 tossed POLLEN tips; 7 POLLEN no tip, 8th tossed POLLEN tips (each up cell starts with 3 NECTAR).

open_questions: Tilt in play: nominal 30 deg (Fig 9-10 + CAD) is the damper-stop angle; real fields vary (Cells may be 'tweaked' by hand per Setup Guide 12.1, dampers compress). Bounds from checklist 1.13 (lip 53.5 +- 0.5 in), exact solve: 28.80-31.77 deg with the pivot at nominal height; 25.90-34.83 deg if the pivot is also off by 1 in (derived, PM-015; the precomputed sweeps still use the older linear +-1.5 / +-4.5 deg labels until re-swept). A field measurement would settle it.

2D section is the HIVE centre plane s=0 where the mouth is tallest (0.356 m). Off-centre the roof is lower (pentagon, 0.193 m at the side walls) - a 3D or y-offset check is needed for shots that are not centred.
A-frame legs are drawn as projected segments; at s=0 only their top exists. hive.py should either ignore 'projected' obstacles for centred shots or treat them as conservative.

Rib geometry simplified: roof outer drawn at rib-top height 13.12 in over the full cell length (skin between ribs is 12.70 in); underside drawn at rib-bottom 2.97 in (tube is 2.71 in). Errors <= 0.42 in (11 mm).
Ballast washers / wing nut on a 10-32 x 2 in screw 'at the end of each Cell nearest its opening' (Setup Guide 12.1) are not in the CAD section; location and protrusion unknown.

G417 C vs H: whether an intentional shot that grazes the rim/roof edge on the way in counts as 'deliberately LAUNCHING into the external top' is a referee judgement; ask on the Q&A forum before designing a bank shot.
No launch zone found in TU07; later Team Updates could add one - re-check the current manual before relying on this.
3 NECTAR (3.6 in) preloaded in each up cell occupy the back corner on the perimeter side; their effect on retention/bounce is not modelled here.
POLLEN diameter is 'approximately 2.8 in (7.1 cm)'; real ball-to-ball variation not given.
